mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, quantity, created_at AS createdAt FROM cart_item WHERE created_at <= #{olderThan} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT i.product_id AS productId, i.unit_price_cent AS unitPriceCent, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM shop_order_item i JOIN shop_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status != 'CANCELED' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id FROM shop_order o WHERE o.status != 'CANCELED'
SELECT id, user_id AS userId FROM shop_order WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND created_at <= #{cutoff} ORDER BY created_at ASC
